cards.name: Langfuse
cards.notes: No `ops_service`: the card is a link + health probe, not a lifecycle control. Restarting Langfuse means recreating six coupled containers (the app services gate on service_healthy datastores), which a single ops-api start/stop button cannot express - a half-applied restart would leave web up against a stopped ClickHouse. Use the compose profile instead. `check` is the public health endpoint langfuse-web serves without auth; it is the same probe the container healthcheck runs.
